notes: Names printed without a suffix (BAYMILLER, RAVINE, MOHAWK, BYRON, LARABEE, CLEARWATER, WILMINK, LINN, BANK) are written with 'Street'. Baymiller leans about 7 deg (centre ~1550 at Klotter, ~1350 at McMicken) and does not continue as a street between McMicken and the canal (only a 5 ft stair passage to the foot bridge); south of the canal it is 40' (centre ~1157-1188). Klotter and Browne Alley both continue west of Baymiller in the sheet-237 margin, so both are crosses; Klotter is steeper near Baymiller and flattens to the east. Quarry Street is a 5-8 ft passage from Klotter to McMicken; a ~4 ft gap continues it north of Klotter (offset ~20 px east), so Quarry/Klotter is marked cross; Browne Alley ends at Quarry (the church lot fence is continuous on the east side). Ravine Street: Klotter and Mohawk end at it (Ravine's east line is continuous at Klotter, west line continuous at Mohawk). Mohawk (no width printed, ~32 ft) runs east from Ravine and curves SE off the sheet. Ravine ends at McMicken; the Ravine/McMicken point is where the Ravine centreline (x~5630) meets the SSE leg of McMicken, which is ~110 px east of McMicken's bend. The '?' on McMicken at (6067,2906) is an unnamed ~28 ft street leaving McMicken's NE side toward the NE into the sheet-228/238 margin; it is offset ~145 px NW of Byron, so both are T. Conroy (printed at the top right edge, east of Ravine) has its crossing with Ravine off the top of the page; not recorded. Central Avenue bends at about the Larabee junction (about 12 deg below east to the west, about 18 deg to the east). Linn Street jogs ~670 px (~110 ft) at Bank: the north part (Central to Bank, centre ~4320) and the south part (labelled LINN below Bank, centre ~4994) each end at Bank, so two T points. Wilmink Street (20') from the west and Brown Alley (~20 ft, no width printed) from the east meet Linn about 28 px apart, essentially a crossing with a small jog; recorded as two T points. Brown Alley, Bank and Central run off east into the undrawn area beyond x~5200 (not real ends). Wilmink meets Baymiller as a T (the sheet-226 margin shows no opening opposite it on this sheet). FLASK YARD (between Central and Clearwater, x~3360-3500) is a yard, not a street. Larabee Street has no width printed (~40 ft as drawn). Canal, tow path, foot bridge and railroad ignored.
